description: How The Aether Wars (Unreal Engine 5.8) draws a strand groom: the groom asset's strand width with its root and tip scale, and the hair material's root-to-tip base colour (linear). build_groom_review.py renders a groom this way so gaps between locks read as they do in game.
source: TheAetherWars Tools/EnnixPlayer.py: make_groom (hair_width, hair_root_scale, hair_tip_scale) and make_materials (hair RootColor, TipColor)
